title: Planned change: A/R Print is now Export > Download (PDF)
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • You are signed in to ShopView as an Admin user.
custom_steps:
1. Open the Reports menu.
  2. Click "A/R Aging Detail" in the left list.
  3. Look for the printer button.
  4. Click the Export menu (⋯ beside the title).
  5. Click "Download (PDF)".
  6. Open the downloaded file.
  7. Read its heading.
  8. Read the bottom of page 1.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 4:

  • PRD v12, S3-R1, quoted: “Each of the six reports has the native report Export menu (the ⋯ button at the right of the title row, labelled "Export report") with "Download (PDF)" and "Download (CSV)". A/R's former Print button is replaced by this menu. The A/P reports gain a PDF.”
  • Step 3 (our restatement, not the PRD's words): There is no printer button; the ⋯ Export menu offers "Download (PDF)" and "Download (CSV)".

Step 5:

  • PRD v12, S3-R2, quoted: “The PDF downloads as a file.”
  • Step 7 (unchanged from before the release): The PDF shows the report name, your organization's name and the "As of" line.
  • Step 8 (unchanged from before the release): "Software Powered by ShopView" and "Page 1 of N" at the bottom.
  • Related existing case: S3-01b C715595 (https://shopview.testrail.io/index.php?/cases/view/715595); D-35 C715515 (https://shopview.testrail.io/index.php?/cases/view/715515). This case checks the same planned change from the before-the-release side.

Why this matters: The printed report must still be obtainable, with the same heading and footer.

SOURCE: A/R and A/P Report Sorting, Export and Location Filter PRD (Confluence 947650561) v12, 12 Nov 2026, S3-R1; S3-R2. V1 behaviour before the change: ShopView/shopview at fc08f23 (production v26.45.3), app/src/components/ts/reporting/accounts-receivable/PrintARReportButton.vue:1-14; app/src/components/ts/reporting/accounts-receivable/PrintARReportButton.vue:40-76; api/templates/reporting/account-receivable/aging-detail.html.twig:125-127; api/templates/reporting/account-receivable/aging-detail.html.twig:8-14.

This is the expected behaviour as per the A/R and A/P Report Sorting, Export and Location Filter PRD (Confluence 947650561) v12, 12 Nov 2026, S3-R1, S3-R2, for epic SV-11315; the V1 behaviour it changes is recorded in AR-AP-V1-BASELINE.md (INV-061). Last checked against build v26.45.4-b8c04e2 (staging) on 11/12/2026.

AUTOMATION: READY
